name: Cert_Graveyard_Lookup
author: Luca Memini
description: Search revoked or malicious code-signing certificates from The Cert Graveyard

configurationItems.name: mode
configurationItems.description: Use 'online' for API queries or 'local' to use the downloaded CSV

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: API key for Cert Graveyard (required for online mode)

configurationItems.name: local_db_path
configurationItems.description: Local CSV path (relative to analyzer folder if not absolute)

configurationItems.name: cache_max_hours
configurationItems.description: Max age of local CSV before refresh

configurationItems.name: other_search_parameter
configurationItems.description: When dataType is other (online mode), choose: signer, issuer-short, issuer, serial
